newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia forex reserves hit $19.125 bln in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia forex reserves hit $19.125 bln in Dec.

text.p: Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves rose to $19.125 billion in December from $17.825 billion in November, a government official told Reuters on Friday.
The official did not give specific reasons for the rise, but dealers said it might be partly due to recent central bank support for the dollar to keep it within its intervention band.
Central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said foreign exchange reserves were expected to rise to $20 billion in the 1997/98 fiscal year (April-March).
Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves totalled $16.574 billion in October and $16.414 billion in September.
